\chapter{One small step into school}
\label{ch:zh-primary-three}
\hlchaptermodality{14}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can understand, say, read and write \zh{小}, \zh{小学} and \zh{小学生}, gaining only the three-stroke \zh{小} before recombining it with the already secure \zh{学} and \zh{生}.}

One new glyph expands into three official Level 1 words, each checked independently in listening, speaking, unassisted reading and no-model writing.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[xiǎo]{Hear \emph{xiǎo} — small}

\label{lesson:ZH-C14-hear-xiao}



\begin{quote}
Say \textbf{big} and \textbf{university}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{xiǎo} — \textbf{small; little}
\end{quote}

Keep the voice low through the third tone: \emph{xiǎo}. Work only with sound and meaning. Its three-stroke character comes next.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://hsk.cn-bj.ufileos.com/3.0/\%E6\%96\%B0\%E7\%89\%88HSK\%E8\%80\%83\%E8\%AF\%95\%E5\%A4\%A7\%E7\%BA\%B21219.pdf}{Official HSK 3.0 syllabus, Level 1 vocabulary}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[xiǎo]{\zh{小} — centre, left, right}

\label{lesson:ZH-W14-xiao}



\begin{quote}
Say \textbf{small} in Mandarin.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — the shape}
Draw the centre vertical first and finish its hook without lifting. Add the short left-falling mark. Finish with the right dot, leaving air around the centre. Three strokes; two lifts.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Trace \textbf{\zh{小}} once. Copy it once while saying \textbf{centre, left, right}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/68d10a4b21150cae5e1ebbd223eed289cf32d90c/data/\%E5\%B0\%8F.json}{Hanzi Writer Data \zh{小}, pinned stroke paths and medians}.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[xiǎoxué]{Hear \emph{xiǎoxué} — primary school}

\label{lesson:ZH-C14-hear-xiaoxue}



\begin{quote}
Say \textbf{small}, then \textbf{study}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{xiǎoxué} — \textbf{primary school; elementary school}
\end{quote}

Keep \emph{xiǎo} low, then let \emph{xué} rise. No new character is hiding in this word.

\section[xiǎoxuésheng]{Hear \emph{xiǎoxuésheng} — primary-school student}

\label{lesson:ZH-C14-hear-xiaoxuesheng}



\begin{quote}
Say \textbf{primary school}, then \textbf{student}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{xiǎoxuésheng} — \textbf{primary-school student}
\end{quote}

Say three beats: low \emph{xiǎo}, rising \emph{xué}, light \emph{sheng}. \zh{学} appears only once where the two familiar words overlap.

\end{tcolorbox}

\section[Practice]{Retrieve three primary-school words}

\label{lesson:ZH-R14-primary-three}



\begin{quote}
Write \zh{小}, \zh{学}, and \zh{生} once each from memory.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Hear \textbf{small}, \textbf{primary school}, and \textbf{primary-school student} in mixed order. Say, read, and write each. Then contrast \zh{大学} with \zh{小学} and \zh{大学生} with \zh{小学生}. Repair only the missed item.

\section[Practice]{Payoff — three primary-school words in four skills}

\label{lesson:ZH-C14-practice}



\begin{quote}
Write \zh{小}, \zh{学}, and \zh{生} without a model.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
1. \textbf{Listening:} hear the three forms in mixed order and choose each meaning. 2. \textbf{Speaking:} produce all three from meaning cards, with tones audible. 3. \textbf{Reading:} read all three character cards without pinyin. 4. \textbf{Writing:} hear all three and write them without a model.

Pass each skill separately. Repair and retry only the failed skill.
